input_selection_rule: Lowest two archived MMFF-converged stereochemically qualified conformers after excluding the previously used C001; not selected using observed spectra or IR match.

conformer.energy_kind: MMFF94s force-field, not DFT or free energy

provenance.generator_method: Archived RDKit ETKDGv3 followed by converged MMFF94s from verified stereochemical graph
provenance.chemical_identity_basis: Archived formula, graph and SDF roundtrip InChIKey verification plus fresh byte hashes/element order/bond table/mapped handedness checks. No new RDKit/CIP computation.

scientific_limits: Algorithm-generated conformers, not experimental crystal geometries.
MMFF ranking does not establish DFT energy order, thermodynamic abundance or global minimum.
Independent starting geometries may relax into the same conformational basin; final aligned geometry/dihedral/energy comparisons must disclose this without mixing lane caches.
IR and frequency qualification depend on each actual optimized geometry and explicitly recorded method; old C001 Hessian/modes are not reused as these conformers results.
No conformer-population-weighted spectrum or chemical assignment to herb THz peaks is established.
